findings.message: This assertion removes `undefined` or `null` from the value's type without a check, the same claim a `!` makes. From here on the type says the value is present, so the compiler stops asking, and a fallback after it (`?? fallback`) reads as dead code. Keep `| undefined` in the asserted type and handle it, check the value first, use `required(value, 'why it is present')` from `@nexus/source/errors/Assert`, or read a command-line flag through `stringFlag` or `numberFlag`.
